# Herdown Full Context

Herdown is a clean-data extraction product for AI workflows.

It focuses on:
- Web pages
- Documents
- Images and screenshots
- Markdown output
- JSON structured output
- Sitemap discovery

It is not trying to replace downstream knowledge base systems.

Recommended downstream tools:
- Dify
- Coze
- FastGPT
- n8n

Core user promise:
- Take messy source material and turn it into clean material that AI tools can use directly.
